prompt:
Generate a ten-second energetic realistic product-review shot from this exact opening photograph. Keep the product identity: The unboxed Coco Bear PRO kettle shown in the supplied reference: ivory-white rounded base, clear glass jug partly filled with clear water, thick ivory handle on the right, metallic collar below the jug rim, transparent lid with ivory bear-shaped knob, black rounded front control panel with Coco Bear logo, dual temperature readouts and original buttons. Keep exactly the supplied product design, shape, colors and visible controls. Do not change into a blender or coffee machine. The kettle stands on the worktop, removed from the reference transport box. Do not invent new controls or functions.
Maintain this exact room, lighting and the same single fictional adult presenter throughout this clip. The person remains in the same clothes and place. TARGET LOCK: track the KETTLE, not the person. Keep the kettle centered at the middle of the frame, with its complete base, spout, lid and handle within the central 80 percent of the frame, all the way to the final frame. If necessary reduce the orbit angle rather than let any part leave the image. Smooth brisk 30-degree camera arc from the original front viewpoint toward the handle side over ten seconds. Dolly OUT by ten percent first, then continue sideways with the lens always aimed at the kettle center. Constant visible parallax, no big pan following the presenter. Product tracking keeps the kettle complete and centered even at the end; maintain enough space on both sides.
The motion begins immediately and stays visibly active at normal speed, smooth gimbal tracking with natural background parallax. Brief gentle ease-in and ease-out only, no long static pauses, no ultra-slow motion, no abrupt jerk. The product stays rigid, stationary on the tabletop; camera moves around it. Do not show an invented rear view or spin it 360 degrees.
Presenter makes one small natural open-palm gesture beside the product, then relaxes; a subtle friendly smile and normal blinking. Presenter remains upright in the original position; do not lean down, bend, walk or follow the camera. Keep hands clear of product and facial gestures restrained. Mouth stays naturally relaxed; this is a separate voice-over, no speaking or lip-sync. Do not pick up, pour from or operate the appliance. No extra fingers or arms. Preserve kettle shape, handle, lid, front controls, logo and digits consistently. No changes to parts, morphing, moving letters, boiling steam, scene changes, subtitles or added graphics. No music, no narration, no sound effects. Full-screen vertical 9:16, 720p, one continuous shot at normal camera speed.
